standard.summary: 选择实验日志的记录后端。tensorboard 在本地记录训练曲线；wandb 上传到 Weights & Biases 云端。
standard.effect: tensorboard 生成本地事件文件，可通过 TensorBoard UI 查看。wandb 提供云端 dashboard、超参搜索和团队协作。
standard.whenToUse: tensorboard 是最轻量的选择。wandb 适合需要远程监控或团队协作时。
standard.avoidWhen: wandb 需要网络和 API key。不想上传数据时用 tensorboard。

optionDescriptions.wandb: 传到 W&B，要账号和 key。

standard_en.summary: Picks the experiment logging backend. tensorboard records the training curves locally; wandb uploads them to Weights & Biases.
standard_en.effect: tensorboard writes local event files you can open in the TensorBoard UI. wandb provides a cloud dashboard, hyperparameter sweeps and team collaboration.
standard_en.whenToUse: tensorboard is the lightest choice. wandb suits remote monitoring or working in a team.
standard_en.avoidWhen: wandb needs network access and an API key. Use tensorboard when you would rather not upload anything.

optionDescriptions.tensorboard: View the curves in local TensorBoard.
optionDescriptions.wandb: Uploads to W&B; needs an account and a key.

advanced.principle: Lulynx 通过 Accelerate 的 tracker 接口集成日志后端。tensorboard 写入 logging_dir 下的事件文件。wandb 通过 wandb_api_key 认证并上传到 wandb.ai。adaptive_step_logging 自动调整日志频率——当 step 日志耗时超过阈值时降低频率。
advanced.intervention: 训练启动时初始化 tracker，每步记录 loss/lr/epoch 等指标。
advanced.expectedImpact: 不影响训练质量。tensorboard_flush_interval_steps 控制写入频率。
advanced.tradeoffs: layer_monitor_enabled 额外记录每层的梯度/权重统计（用于调试）。wandb_run_name 设置运行名称。

advanced_en.principle: Lulynx integrates logging backends through Accelerate's tracker interface. tensorboard writes event files under logging_dir. wandb authenticates via wandb_api_key and uploads to wandb.ai. adaptive_step_logging auto-adjusts logging frequency — lowering it when step-logging time exceeds a threshold.
advanced_en.intervention: Initializes the tracker at training start and records loss/lr/epoch metrics per step.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Does not affect training quality. tensorboard_flush_interval_steps controls write frequency.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: layer_monitor_enabled additionally records per-layer gradient/weight statistics (for debugging). wandb_run_name sets the run name.
